project_type: Syrabit AI - Educational assistant monorepo with Cloudflare Pages frontend, Cloudflare Worker edge, Cloud Run FastAPI backend
language: Bash (for audit script), Python (backend), TypeScript (edge worker, frontend)
build_system: standalone bash script - no build system needed
test_framework: Script is self-testing (runs checks against live deployment)
verification_instructions: 1. Run bash -n scripts/live-deployment-audit.sh to verify syntax. 2. Run chmod +x scripts/live-deployment-audit.sh. 3. Run ./scripts/live-deployment-audit.sh --help to verify argument parsing. 4. Run ./scripts/live-deployment-audit.sh --quick to verify basic execution against live site.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - script uses curl, jq, openssl, dig which are pre-installed
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access available. Can reach syrabit.ai and api.syrabit.ai. curl, jq, openssl, dig all available.
contribution_requirements: Script should be in scripts/ directory. Use same coding style as existing scripts (fullstack-layer-test.sh, live-deployment-test.sh).
key_patterns: Existing scripts use: set -euo pipefail, color output with terminal detection, PASS/FAIL/WARN categorization, summary at end, environment variable configuration, --help/--quick flags. The fullstack-layer-test.sh uses sections per layer with counters. The live-deployment-test.sh uses perform_request() helper with timing metrics.
relevant_files: scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh (6738 lines, 1000+ assertions - pattern reference for structure and style)
scripts/live-deployment-test.sh (599 lines - pattern for timing/request helpers)
infra/gcp/clouddeploy.yaml (Cloud Run config: minScale=1, maxScale=10, 1Gi/1CPU, port 8000)
apps/edge/wrangler.toml (Worker config: KV namespaces, R2, backend URL)
directory_structure: scripts/ - deployment/test scripts | apps/backend/ - FastAPI Python app | apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker (TS) | apps/frontend/ - Vite SPA | infra/gcp/ - Cloud Run deployment config
